---
description: "Forms windows, popups, workspaces, window management, and window events"
---

- Forms windows and workspaces group overview:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Api-Windows.h`
- Create and show top-level windows, title, content, modality, native handles:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Window.h`
- Configure window borders, title bars, and native window frame behavior:

- Select top-level, dialog, popup, tool, or other window types:

- Host managed windows within a control:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Workspace.h`
- Manage windows owned by a workspace:
  `include/Pt/Forms/WorkspaceManager.h`
- Create popup windows and position them relative to controls:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Popup.h`
- Handle window activation and deactivation:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ActivateEvent.h`
- Handle window close requests:
  `include/Pt/Forms/CloseEvent.h`
- Handle window movement:
  `include/Pt/Forms/MoveEvent.h`
- Handle window resize requests and new bounds:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ResizeEvent.h`
- Handle window show and hide changes:
  `include/Pt/Forms/ShowEvent.h`
- Handle native window state changes:
  `include/Pt/Forms/WindowStateEvent.h`
